The connection between the mannequin neck and the surface below is ambiguous and slightly distorted. The edge of the mannequin's shoulder blends into the foreground objects unnaturally.
The background bokeh contains shapes that are difficult to resolve into coherent objects, suggesting slight geometric warping typical of generative models.
